scope: after qexInit through ordinary output; excludes timing report and qexFinalize
aggregation: min/mean/max across ranks of accumulated local elapsed time; includes communication within each region; no per-region barriers
accounting: exclusive phases; sum of rank means including other equals total rank mean; maxima can belong to different ranks and must not be summed as wall time

gauge_flow.description: Gauge force, RK matrix exponentials/link updates, gauge work buffers, flow reunitarization; excludes HISQ construction and measurements

fermion_flow.description: All source fields: directional HISQ Laplacians, RK vector updates, and fermion work buffers; excludes HISQ construction

contractions.description: All source/color contractions, normalization, time alignment, source averaging and correlator JSON assembly; excludes HISQ construction

solve.description: Zeroing each solution and stag.solve, including solver setup and communication; excludes HISQ construction and source generation/I/O

hisq_links_flow.description: HISQ construction and staggered-operator setup at all three RK stages, shared by all source fields

hisq_links_solve.description: HISQ construction and staggered-operator setup before the solves, shared by all source fields

hisq_links_contractions.description: HISQ construction at each correlator measurement, shared by all source fields

gauge_measurements.description: Gauge observables, including flowMeasurements and diagnostic plaquettes

flow_diagnostics.description: Diagnostic propagator/work-vector norms and flow-state printing

source_generation.description: Noise RNG field initialization and construction/validation of wall sources

source_io.description: Source QIO existence check, write, readback and exact field verification

output_io.description: Observable/metadata serialization and file writes; excludes timing-report output

other.description: Other setup, bookkeeping, logging, garbage collection and timer overhead
